text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, hey, hey! Bright-san, where do you buy 
your pajamas? The ones you wore yesterday 
were so frilly and cute—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. It's from a shop I frequent. The 
fabric is sturdy, and it keeps you so warm 
and cozy~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! They're nice and thick... so I 
thought they'd be great for keeping off 
the chill! Ooh~! If there's one that suits 
me, I wanna buy it~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~. In that case, why don't you try 
wearing it too, Lady Tsuru-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I made a mistake with 
the order quantity~, so I have an extra 
nightgown just like this one.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whaat?! Then... we-we're matching?! 
Bright-san and me?! Is... is that really 
okay, I wonder...?!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Lady Tsuru-chan is so very 
adorable, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
There is simply no way it would not look 
splendid on someone I find so utterly 
adorable~

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to try wearing it!! Could you lend 
it to me tonight!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Coming from Bright-san, a total 
pro at being cute, that means a lot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. Well then, tonight shall be... a 
fluffy pajama party, won't it~♪
